nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The culvert. The tarp is frozen stiff.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: Airman! Your light's still working. I kept it on all winter. They never came in. Not once.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: There's more of them now. Up the creek. They walk your plant's fence every night. Counting the lights.

nodes.speaker: amb_salt
nodes.text: I'm coming with you. Ha. Don't look like that. I can carry. I'm warm-blooded too.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Salt is in his camp chair, frozen. His eyes are open toward the steam. The snow around him is full of long tracks.
